collection.title: Kia EV4 2025 to 2026 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Kia EV4 2025 Onwards requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" blade on the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
